derived_projection_analysis.interpretation: In the current 2D projection, all three horizontal/Mother-class crossings move laterally opposite to the five diagonal/Simple-class ascents. Their signed lateral displacement cancels exactly, leaving a net six-level ascent and zero lateral drift.

phrase_partition.posture: This is a rendering aid: horizontal crossings may be made perceptually legible as phrase boundaries, but they acquire no recognition or metaphysical priority.
